items.rationale: Remains of insured property (shed, a declared site installation) damaged by storm-thrown tree; clearance under 5.2.1(a) is indemnified. Small disposal line, kept moderate.

items.description: Disposal of broken shed glass pane
items.rationale: Broken glazing is a remnant of insured property under 5.2.1(a), so disposal is covered. It is a very small load and the price should be low.

items.description: Disposal of green waste from felled tree
items.rationale: Branches and foliage felled by the storm are material arising under 5.2.1(b), so disposal is covered.

items.description: Disposal of root ball under 1 m3
items.rationale: The root mass of a felled tree forming a single mass of 1 m3 or less counts as material arising under 5.2.1(b), so it is covered despite the vegetation exclusion in 4.3(e).
Ground material is not material arising under 5.2.1(d). Standing-alone disposal without reinstatement and making good of the ground (5.2.2) is not covered.
Paving grit is ground material under 1.3. The paving is not a terrace, and there is no reinstatement or making good, so the disposal is not covered.
Excavated soil is ground material under 5.2.1(d). Disposal as a standing-alone clearance measure is excluded under 5.2.2.
